WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    sites.healtheval as col1,
    SUM(scans.scancount) as col2,
    AVG(CAST(scans.gbsize AS REAL) / scans.spanmin) as col3
  FROM scans
  JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref
  WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY sites.healtheval
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(col3) as avg_col3
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.col1,
  step1.col2,
  step1.col3,
  step1.col3 - step2.avg_col3 as col4
FROM step1
CROSS JOIN step2
WHERE step2.avg_col3 IS NOT NULL
